rule: Residuals are not negative assertions unless explicitly falsified. Missing authority and QU remain unresolved rather than being promoted.

entries.title: extensional carrier comprehension
entries.assertion: Every valid extensional support/residual/q content has a carrier object.
entries.reason: Current primitive formulas define target content but do not assert object comprehension.
entries.falsifier_or_closer: Represent and qualify an exact comprehension/construction authority, or prove totality by another represented witness construction.

entries.title: unconditional non-immediate Q_STEP totality
entries.assertion: Every legal non-immediate action has a Q_STEP successor object.
entries.reason: Functionality is proved up to extensional equality; target carrier existence is not.

entries.title: unconditional VALUE totality
entries.assertion: Every Q_VALID q has exactly one VALUE token.
entries.reason: Uniqueness and well-founded recurrence are established, but existence still requires successor carrier witnesses.

entries.title: NEI classification for q_o/q_r referents
entries.assertion: QO_EQ or QR_EQ implies NEI SAME/DISTINCT/UNKNOWN under a future-behavior identity query.
entries.reason: Structural equivalence is exact evidence, but no admissible identity-model family/extensional identity theorem is represented.
entries.falsifier_or_closer: Represent the identity query/model family and independently qualify the theorem that forces an exact NEI result.

entries.title: Bayesian identity weight
entries.assertion: Controls, benchmark repetitions, q congruence or DP recurrence provide a Bayes factor/posterior for identity.

entries.title: runtime fairness and completion
entries.assertion: Workers eventually execute every needed semantic dependency or the solver necessarily returns.
entries.reason: OS scheduling, event delivery, task retirement and related runtime realization remain unresolved; acyclic q semantics does not prove execution fairness.

entries.title: net performance benefit of q_r sharing
entries.assertion: Increasing cross-task q_r sharing reduces total cycles or wall time.
entries.reason: Duplicate frequency, work avoided, publication/probe/coherence cost, displacement and scheduling remain unresolved execution economics.

entries.title: literal PROMOTE reflection transport
entries.assertion: QR_EQ(q,t) makes PROMOTE columns transport by c->6-c.
entries.reason: Reflection-equivariant effect classes plus the fixed asymmetric tie order admit a reflection-fixed countermodel where column 2 is promoted but reflected column 4 is not.

entries.title: full game-move commutation from cofactor/support commutation
entries.assertion: Distinct legal Q_STEP moves may be freely reordered because support/cofactor suboperations commute.
entries.reason: Alternating mover polarity and first-win stopping are load-bearing barriers.

entries.title: remaining 0.3 representation-equivalence primitive closures
entries.assertion: All seven retained representation-equivalence claims are fully native primitive support.
entries.reason: Pair incidence/singleton/raw cell-mask structure are partially expanded, but prepared pi32 hash carriage, isolated-bit operation semantics, helper relocation and grow/widen order equivalence are not yet all represented natively below their domain labels.

entries.title: supporting primitive-theory qualification
entries.assertion: Vendored primitive arithmetic/data supporting candidates are independently promoted authority.
entries.reason: Their exact clauses are embedded/pinned for this successor but their qualification burden is inherited by the successor rather than silently upgraded.

entries.title: physical-domain reachability bridge
entries.assertion: Every Q_VALID semantic object corresponds to a legally reachable standard Connect4 history, or the exact reachable subset is fully characterized.
entries.reason: The current primitive slice models ordinary q semantics but does not yet supply a complete initial-state/reachability bridge from C4-0001 physical histories.

entries.title: concurrent second-50-percent optimization evidence
entries.assertion: New wide/deep, bound-split, coalescing or selective-sharing benchmark findings alter this IA fixed point.
entries.reason: Those owner-branch commits were produced concurrently after the frozen primitive assertion base and are execution research, not premises of this semantic closure run.
entries.next_action: Re-enter them only through a separately frozen successor/re-evaluation if their semantics are incorporated into the primitive graph.
